name: Otherworldy Seeming Boy
original_name: 浮世離れした雰囲気の少年
source:
A mysterious kid the protagonist sees at the school after she transfers in.
He looks about 10 years old, but he has a great atmosphere around him and talks very old fashioned.
He knows about [url=/c24704]Reimon[/url] and can even talk to it.
